episode_summary: In this episode, Julia Linquist discusses the challenges of balancing a high-stress real estate career with family life. Michael Opyd provides actionable insights on time management, setting income goals, and the importance of delegation to achieve a sustainable business model. Listeners will learn how to reduce stress and improve work-life balance while maintaining high production levels.
